purpose: Independent external evaluation of the frozen vehicle-fueling control, precooling and tank-response chain on an uninspected protocol family.

source.title: SAE J2601 MC Default Bench Test Data
source.redistribution: not_permitted_without_a_separate_license; acquire from the publisher URL

selected_workbooks: MC Default Validation Test - 9.8kg Type IV - 2014Dec30.xlsx

excluded_members.reason: lookup-table comparison files, derived comparison workbook and narrative PDFs are not independent MC Default outcome cases
patterns: MC Default and Lookup Table Test Results - Comparison

analysis_rules: Parse measured time, pressure, tank-gas temperature, inlet temperature, chamber temperature, mass flow and SOC without outcome-dependent smoothing or dynamic time warping.
Use the experimental clock and pre-declared active-fill detection rule; record every parser exclusion with its reason.
Do not alter model parameters, screens or selected cases after opening the selected workbook outcomes.
Report all eight cases, including failures, and retain the existing negative Tables Method full-loop result.

This dataset can test the vehicle-fueling control, precooling and tank-response chain; it cannot by itself establish field-wide station safety or observe internal bank dispatch commands that were not instrumented.
freeze_note: Only the publisher landing page, archive hash, archive member names and prior literature descriptions were inspected before this file was written. Selected workbook sheets and numerical outcomes were not opened.
